DLP Dictionary Resource Validate DLP Pattern
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/dlpDictionaries/validateDlpPattern

Validates the pattern used by a Pattern and Phrases DLP dictionary type, and provides error information if the pattern is invalid. To learn more about how to define valid patterns for custom DLP dictionaries, see Defining Patterns for Custom DLP Dictionaries.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
